subtitle: One administrator workflow across Entra, Defender, Purview and Sentinel.
purpose: Discover what is missing, prepare a reviewable deployment plan, execute approved changes and establish which controls actually work.
rows:

separately promote or disable the policy.

Read available hunting evidence; deploy
the XDR-to-Sentinel connector.

Enable unified audit; create a scoped DLP
policy and rule in simulation mode.

Workspace, connectors, 3 hunts, watchlist,
2 rules, workbook and incident-task automation.
left:
1  Select tenant and workload scope.
2  Assess prerequisites and existing settings.
3  Review and approve each exact plan.
4  Deploy, then verify data and behavior.
5  Approve activation; review drift afterward.
right:
Development/test live targets only.
Defender Security for AI setup is separate.
DLP enforcement is not automated.
Response playbooks are human procedures;
executable response runbooks are planned.
note:
Service licenses, permissions and availability remain prerequisites.
Created resources and successful readback do not establish runtime protection.
